chunks: Whosoever repents and does the right, will have turned back to God by way of repentance;

key_terms.مَتَابًا: a way of turning back / acceptance

ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for accepted repentance in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate the completeness of repentance, where the combination of sincere remorse and righteous action transforms the sinner into one who is fully reconciled with Allah. It underscores the concept of 'Mataban' (a complete return), highlighting that true tawbah is not merely a verbal declaration but a transformative state validated by subsequent good deeds.
